ui_system.name: neutral_system_ui_premium
ui_system.objective: Rebuild the provided component into a high-craft production UI component. The interface must feel responsive, intelligent, and spatially aware. Motion and visual atmosphere should enhance usability, not distract from content.

visual_atmosphere.forbidden: neon_ui rainbow_gradients glowing_borders glass_panels heavy_blur_backdrops attention_grabbing_backgrounds

motion_architecture.principle: Every animation must communicate either: - state change - spatial relationship - input feedback
motion_architecture.framer_motion_layer: hover_feedback focus_transition button_press tooltip_fade dropdown_open_close tab_transition modal_presence
motion_architecture.gsap_layer: layout_shift_animation auto_height_expansion sidebar_expand_collapse command_palette_open panel_reveal measured_accordion

component_rules.required: accessible_aria keyboard_navigation responsive dark_mode composable_api variant_support

workflow.phase: Analyze architecture, accessibility, and scalability issues in the component.
Define user interaction flow and where motion clarifies behavior.
Add subtle background atmosphere and gradient usage that does not affect readability.
Implement using React + Next.js + Tailwind. Use Framer Motion for micro-interactions and GSAP for layout transitions. Ensure accessibility and reduced-motion fallback.
